{{- /* The page's trail, from the site root down. params.breadcrumbs.root ({name, url} list) goes in front, for crumbs above this site (the live docs start with "All Products"); params.productName names the site root crumb, which is otherwise the site title. */ -}} {{- if (default true site.Params.features.breadcrumbs) -}} {{- $ancestors := .Ancestors.Reverse -}} {{- if $ancestors -}} {{- $cfg := site.Params.breadcrumbs | default dict -}} {{- /* A version's own home (a section right under the site root: latest/, 11.xx/) is what the site crumb already names, so on that page the trail ends at the site crumb instead of adding a second crumb after it. */ -}} {{- $onContentHome := and .Parent .Parent.IsHome -}} {{- $siteName := site.Params.productName -}}
{{- range $cfg.root -}} {{ .name }} / {{- end -}} {{- range $i, $a := $ancestors -}} {{- $isContentHome := and $a.Parent $a.Parent.IsHome -}} {{- if not $isContentHome -}} {{- if $i }}/{{ end -}} {{- $name := cond $a.IsHome ($siteName | default $a.LinkTitle) $a.LinkTitle -}} {{- if and $onContentHome $a.IsHome -}} {{ $name }} {{- else -}} {{ $name }} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not $onContentHome -}} / {{ .LinkTitle }} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- end -}}
